claims.claim_text: Bloom Energy and AEP entered a strategic partnership announced November 2024 for AEP to procure up to 1 GW of solid oxide fuel cells, with an initial 100 MW order; in 2025 began deploying projects across AEP service territory.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: AEP up to 1 GW SOFC; 100 MW initial order; deployment began 2025
claims.source_quote: landmark 1 GW supply agreement with American Electric Power (AEP) that included a 100 MW order in 2024. In 2025, we began working with AEP to deploy projects across the service territory as well as the project development landscape broadly through their capacity as both a channel and financing partner.

claims.claim_text: Bloom Energy entered a $5.0 billion financing framework with Brookfield Asset Management in August 2025 over five years for future Bloom Energy fuel cell projects focused on AI infrastructure.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: $5.0 billion financing framework with Brookfield Asset Management (5 years)
claims.source_quote: In August 2025, we entered into a strategic partnership with Brookfield to support the long-term growth of our fuel cell business and accelerate deployment of clean energy solutions with a focus on powering AI infrastructure. As part of this partnership, we established a prospective financing framework of up to $5.0 billion over five years

claims.claim_text: Bloom Energy entered an October 2025 partnership with Oracle to provide on-site solid state power for AI data centers, agreeing to issue a warrant for 3,531,073 shares at $113.28; $15.9 million of share-based consideration was recognized as a reduction to product revenue based on milestones with the key hyperscaler.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: Oracle on-site SOFC power; warrant up to 3,531,073 shares @ $113.28; $15.9M revenue offset already recognized
claims.source_quote: in October 2025, in connection with our partnership with Oracle Corporation ("Oracle") to provide on-site solid state power for AI data centers ... we agreed to issue to Oracle a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 3,531,073 shares of our common stock, with an exercise price of $113.28 per share ... we recognized $15.9 [million] ... share-based consideration payable to a key hyperscaler customer

claims.claim_text: Bloom has deployed Energy Server systems across approximately 1,100 sites in 9 countries with manufacturing in the U.S., and plans to expand its Fremont, California production capacity to approximately 2 GW by end of 2026.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: approximately 1,100 sites in 9 countries; Fremont expansion to ~2 GW by end of 2026
claims.source_quote: We have deployed our Energy Server systems across approximately 1,100 sites in 9 countries ... These investments ... are part of our strategic plan to increase capacity to approximately 2 GW by the end of 2026.

claims.claim_text: Bloom received IRS notification on March 29, 2024 of acceptance of its application for a Qualifying Advanced Energy Project Credit (Section 48C(e)) of up to $75.3 million for its Fremont, California facility, with DOE recommendation to the IRS.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: $75.3 million Section 48C(e) advanced energy project credit allocation for Fremont CA
claims.source_quote: On March 29, 2024, we received notification from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) of the acceptance of our application for a Qualifying Advanced Energy Project Credit of up to $75.3 million. After a technical review of Bloom's Section 48C(e) application, the Department of Energy provided a recommendation to the IRS to grant a $75.3 million credit allocation for the Facility.

claims.claim_text: Bloom's proprietary solid oxide platform powers the Bloom Electrolyzer; in 2023 demonstrated the world's largest solid oxide electrolyzer at NASA Ames Research Center producing over 2.4 metric tonnes of hydrogen per day with industry-leading efficiency.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: Bloom Electrolyzer SOEC; 2.4 metric tonnes H2/day demonstration at NASA Ames in 2023
claims.source_quote: In 2023, we demonstrated the world's largest solid oxide electrolyzer at NASA's Ames Research Center, producing over 2.4 metric tonnes of hydrogen per day and achieving industry-leading efficiency.

claims.claim_text: Customer concentration: in 2025, three customers (the first of which is the related-party SK ecoplant) represented approximately 12% of total revenue; in 2024 three customers (the first being the related party) represented approximately 14%.
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: Top 3 customers ~12% of 2025 revenue; ~14% of 2024 revenue; #1 is SK ecoplant (related party)
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2025, revenue from three customers*, the first of which is our related party ... 12% of our total revenue.

claims.claim_text: Capital structure transformed in 2025: $2.5 billion 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 issued November 4, 2025 (net proceeds $2.44B), with concurrent exchange transactions retiring $975.9M of existing 3.0% Green Notes; new $600M senior secured revolving credit facility entered December 19, 2025. Cash and equivalents grew to $2,454.1M (from $802.9M) and total recourse debt to $2,613.7M (from $1,124.7M).
claims.subject: Bloom Energy Corp.
claims.object_value: $2.5B 0% Notes due 2030 + $600M RCF; cash $2,454M; recourse debt $2,613.7M; loss on early extinguishment $32.3M
claims.source_quote: On November 4, 2025, we issued the 0% Notes in an aggregate principal amount of $2,500.0 million due November 2030 ... On December 19, 2025, we entered into a senior secured multicurrency revolving credit facility ... in an aggregate available amount of $600.0 million ... As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, we had unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of $2,454.1 million and $802.9 million ... $2,613.7 million and $1,124.7 million of recourse debt
